name: Baked Ziti
desc: Layered ziti bake with beef meat sauce, provolone, sour cream and mozzarella.

source.title: Baked Ziti
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (1 lb ziti, 2 jars 26 oz sauce, 6 oz provolone, 1 1/2 cups sour cream, 6 oz mozzarella) and the same layering order and 350°F, 30-minute bake.

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp butter, for greasing the dish

steps: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the ziti until al dente, about 8 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, brown the ground beef and onion in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains (160°F) and the onion is soft, 8-10 minutes. Spoon off excess fat.
Stir the spaghetti sauce into the beef and simmer for 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Butter a 9x13 in baking dish.
Spread half the ziti in the dish. Cover with the provolone slices, then spread the sour cream over the provolone.
Top with half the meat sauce, the remaining ziti, the mozzarella, and the remaining meat sauce. Sprinkle with the Parmesan.
Bake for about 30 minutes, until heated through and the cheeses are melted.
